other_conditions: Applicant must be an educational institute listed by the Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC)
Applicant must have a valid Startup Cell Registration Number
Institute must have at least one established learning centre in Goa
Institute must be recognized by an authorized government body such as AICTE, UGC, NBA, etc.

Expenditures must be incurred from one year before the notification of the Goa Start‑up Policy 2017 and paid digitally to be considered for reimbursement; if digital payments are not possible, SPC discretion applies
Preference will be given to institutes with tie‑ups with OEMs
Benefits can be availed only once for a period of two consecutive years
Only up to 10 institutes per year may receive benefits
Application can be made at any time of the financial year but only within 6 months of incurring the relevant expenditure
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10,00,000 per year in subsidies for internet, power, capital investment, and salary costs for eligible educational institutes in Goa.
